大号抱号演奏时置于大腿上或大腿之间，苏萨风则把螺旋部分置于肩上。发声时嘴唇贴着金: The tuba is held on the thighs or between them; the sousaphone puts the coil on the shoulder. To sound, the lips are pressed against the metal mouthpiece and the airstream sets them buzzing, which drives a standing wave in the air column inside the tube; the valves change the total length, the basic three lowering the pitch by a major second, a minor second and a minor third and usable in combination, while a fourth valve lowers it by a perfect fourth. Beginners work on tonguing, legato and long tones; double tonguing, triple tonguing and slap tonguing are used less; circular breathing is mastered by some players, and multiphonics appear mostly in modern works. There is usually a water valve at the bottom, which has to be emptied. The instrument is normally written at sounding pitch in bass clef; E♭ and B♭ tubas in brass bands are written transposing in treble clef.
大號主要採用黃銅製造，包括管身、導管及活塞系統。管身由數層黃銅薄片捲製而成，活塞: The tuba is made mainly of brass: body, leadpipe and valve system. The body is rolled from several sheets of brass; the valves are nickel silver or stainless steel, for durability and tone. The inside has a special alloy coating to strengthen the timbre. The mouthpiece is usually brass or German silver, for good sound transmission. The bell at the bottom is made of thickened brass and can be more than 20 cm across, which produces the deep, full tone. The tubing joints are reinforced with rubber and metal rings.
大號具有低沉渾厚、溫潤醇厚的音色特質，音域最低且寬廣，能夠發出極其低迴的聲響，是: The tuba's timbre is deep and full, warm and rounded; its range is the lowest and also wide, and it can produce a very low sound: it is the bass foundation of the brass. Its tone is powerful without losing warmth, resonates well and can fill a room. Against the bright, sharp trumpet it sounds steadier and heavier; against the lively trombone it is more inclusive and stable. In an ensemble the tuba often forms the bass with the double bass and the cello; its sound can stand alone with grandeur, or blend with other instruments into a full bass layer. In solo playing it shows a warm, round quality, with a distinctive expressive force.
大號源自蛇號與指孔大號，為補足低音樂器而發展。1835年，Wieprecht與M: The tuba developed from the serpent and the keyed bugle to fill the need for a bass instrument. In 1835 Wieprecht and Moritz took out the Baß-Tuba patent in Prussia, giving a chromatic bass instrument with five piston valves. From the mid-nineteenth century Sax's E♭ and B♭ saxhorns entered British brass bands; Červený brought out 16′ C and 18′ B♭ tubas in the 1870s. For marching, the helicon was adapted, and in the late 1890s Sousa turned it into the sousaphone.
大號（Tuba）屬氣鳴銅管樂器，可於交響樂團銅管聲部、銅管五重奏、銅管樂團、管樂: The tuba (Tuba) is an aerophone of the brass family, heard in the brass section of the symphony orchestra, in the brass quintet, brass band, wind band, military band, American marching band and Mexican banda music, the last of which often uses the sousaphone; it appears occasionally in jazz and popular music too. From the mid-twentieth century it has also been used as a solo instrument; its concertos include John Williams's, and it appears in symphonic works such as Berlioz's Symphonie fantastique and Stravinsky's The Rite of Spring.
大號（Tuba）為低音至倍低音範圍的氣鳴銅管樂器，H-S 423.232，屬閥鍵: The tuba (Tuba) is an aerophone of the brass family covering the bass to contrabass range, H-S 423.232, in the valved horn family, with a wide conical bore and usually three or four valves, some with five or six; the player buzzes the lips in a deep cup mouthpiece and the valves change the length of tubing. It is used for the brass bass of the symphony orchestra, in the brass quintet, wind band, military band, American marching band and Mexican banda music, and also in jazz and popular music; from the mid-twentieth century it has been used for solos as well.
